title: Issue 2817: execute binding assignments through configured transport

canonical_core.requested_outcome: A binding non-local Planning assignment with an authorized automatic transport compiles to and executes one revision-bound typed dispatch action in the ordinary path, while manual handoff remains an explicit fallback and returned work retains the existing admission, integration, proof, and reconciliation boundary.
canonical_core.hard_constraints: Do not add a scheduler, worker registry, orchestration database, second assignment authority, provider-specific fields to portable assignment semantics, silent local fallback, or completion authority for worker output.
canonical_core.agent_may_decide: Choose the smallest compatible operation and adapter split, exact fixture organization, and PR boundaries while preserving current assignment identity and lifecycle owners.
canonical_core.escalate_when: The fix requires a second assignment record, weakens proof/admission, changes target ranking, expands into #2818 context-cost work, or cannot preserve manual and unavailable transport behavior.
canonical_core.next_action: Implement stack slice 1: make automatic, manual, local, and blocked executor dispositions explicit and route the ordinary primary action to the typed automatic dispatch operation.
proof_expectations: Deterministic retained-local, automatic CLI/internal, manual-only, unavailable/failure, and explicit override fixtures use the same canonical assignment semantics.
Automatic dispatch executes without delegation wording and returned work remains untrusted until existing admission and integration operations succeed.
Generated Python/TypeScript operation surfaces and installed package payloads remain conformant.
completion_criteria: A ready binding non-local assignment with an authorized automatic transport exposes and executes the dispatch operation itself as the primary ordinary action.
Manual-only and unavailable automatic transports never silently fall back to local implementation.
Dispatch is revision-bound and preserves scope, effects, stop conditions, proof obligation, return contract, and adapter identity without creating peer authority.
A substantive no-delegation-wording supported-host trace exercises automatic dispatch and the existing return lifecycle.
Focused, generated-conformance, package, and routed AW proof are green for every changed path.
canonical_core.closeout_decision: Close #2817 only after all three stacked PR slices are merged and current-master evidence satisfies the issue completion rule.

goal: Remove the interpretive seam between a binding non-local assignment and execution of its configured automatic transport.
Deliver the lane as three small stacked PRs: disposition/operation contract, configured execution/lifecycle behavior, and dogfood/closeout evidence.
non_goals: Do not implement #2818 worker-context projection, token telemetry, or cost-aware ranking.
Do not create provider rankings, a scheduler, a worker ledger, a prompt framework, or another assignment lifecycle.
Do not require delegation wording, conversational re-authorization, or local fallback after a binding non-local decision.

intent_continuity.larger intended outcome: Configured best-fit orchestration is an executable ordinary repository path rather than advisory handoff prose.
intent_continuity.this slice completes the larger intended: This lane closes the correctness prerequisite owned by #2817; #2818 remains the separate economy/context follow-on.

execution_bounds.allowed paths: Assignment decision/action compilation, generated operation contracts, configured transport adapters, assignment lifecycle tests, supported-host evidence, release/review docs, and this plan.
execution_bounds.max changed files: Prefer fewer than 18 product/test files per PR and split generated/payload parity mechanically with its owning source slice.
execution_bounds.required validation commands: Focused pytest for operating decision, implement CLI, primitive clients, and external evaluation; generated conformance; routed AW proof; package checks selected from changed paths.
execution_bounds.ask-before-refactor threshold: Ask before replacing the assignment lifecycle, target evidence ranking, or provider-neutral packet schema rather than extending the existing operation seam.
execution_bounds.stop before touching: #2818 cost ranking/context projection, unrelated Planning owners, release v0.51.0 PR content, or provider credentials.

active_milestone.scope: Compile binding executor disposition and automatic dispatch into one primary typed operation.
active_milestone.ready: Current master already materializes canonical assignments and has export/import/admit/integrate lifecycle primitives.

immediate_next_action: Create the first stack branch from master and implement the typed dispatch disposition/operation contract with focused fixtures.
invariants: Canonical assignment identity is the only task/scope/effect authority for dispatch.
Provider adapters execute sealed packets but cannot rerank targets or widen assignment semantics.
Worker returns remain evidence until AW admission, integration, proof, and reconciliation complete.
Automatic transport failure never authorizes local implementation.
validation_commands: uv run --frozen --active --no-sync pytest tests/test_operating_decision.py tests/test_workspace_implement_cli.py tests/test_external_operation_clients.py -q
uv run --frozen --active --no-sync python scripts/run_agentic_workspace.py proof --target . --changed <paths> --format json
completion_criteria: Three reviewable stacked PRs jointly satisfy every #2817 acceptance criterion without absorbing #2818.
The ordinary decision packet makes automatic dispatch executable and manual handoff explicitly fallback-only.
Failure, unavailable transport, returned-work admission, integration, and proof paths remain fail-closed and revision-bound.
No-keyword supported-host evidence demonstrates the real configured path rather than a purpose-built delegation-only scenario.

adaptive_assurance.reason: The lane changes effectful non-local execution authority, failure fallback, and returned-work admission boundaries.

next_action: Implement stack slice 1: typed executor disposition and primary automatic dispatch operation.

claims: Binding non-local automatic assignment is executable through the configured transport without a second delegation decision.
Manual fallback and returned-work trust boundaries remain intact.
requirements: Focused assignment decision/action/lifecycle tests and cross-surface operation conformance pass.
Supported-host no-keyword dogfood executes automatic transport and completes normal return reconciliation.

continuation.residual_intent: Issue #2818 owns context projection and cost-aware ranking after this executable transport prerequisite.
